title: Alcohol Addiction (Alcohol Use Disorder)
description: These daily affirmations support recovery from Alcohol Use Disorder. They complement professional counseling, medical care, and trusted accountability.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder: Alcohol withdrawal can be medically dangerous. Seek medical support for detox when needed. This programme complements professional care and is not a substitute for medical treatment.
safety.escalation: Alcohol withdrawal can be dangerous. Medical detox may be required before or alongside this programme. Seek urgent care for severe symptoms.
